rationale: The agent verified the user via email lookup, accessed the correct account, and used order-detail tools to identify which order contained the fleece jacket. It correctly recognized that the fleece jacket is in order #W2466703 and that the order is not yet delivered, explained that exchanges can only be processed after delivery, and offered an alternative (modifying the pending order) without making any changes. No writes were performed and thus no confirmation step was skipped. The agent did not share or alter any other user’s data. Final guidance was appropriate and aligned with policy. While the exchange itself was not completed due to order status, the agent handled the request properly within policy constraints.
